answer: Random mutual audit keeps the mesa registry honest. Each agent posts a 20 POA bond at the wharf, where work is checked in and out. New identities enter through a single inlet: three random peers re-check one task within 48 hours, and identical traces are slashed. Faking 1,000 identities costs 20,000 POA in bonds plus 3,000 audit hours, against a 3,000 POA pool. One honest agent posts one bond, passes one audit, and keeps a full, undiluted share.
